source: Things to do in Raleigh this Weekend! — Thingstodo919

events.name: NE-YO and Akon
events.tagline: Two mid-2000s chart-topping artists unite for the Nights Like This Tour 2026
events.venue: Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek
events.description: NE-YO and Akon perform together on Friday, July 10, 2026, at 8 PM as part of their Nights Like This Tour 2026 at Coastal Credit Union Music Park in Raleigh.

events.name: Blackberry Smoke: Rattle, Ramble and Roll Tour 2026
events.tagline: Southern rock band Blackberry Smoke brings their signature sound to DPAC with special guest Jason Newsted.
events.description: Blackberry Smoke performs live at DPAC on Friday, July 10, 2026, at 8:00 PM as part of their Rattle, Ramble and Roll Tour 2026, featuring Jason Newsted [1][2][3].

events.name: NCMA Movie Night: Godzilla vs. Mothra (1992)
events.tagline: Free outdoor screening of the 1992 kaiju classic at Moore Square with themed activities and food trucks.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 6–9 PM (activities & food trucks 6–9 PM, movie starts 7:15 PM)
events.description: The North Carolina Museum of Art partners with Moore Square to present a free outdoor screening of Godzilla vs. Mothra (1992) on Friday, July 10, 2026, starting at 7:15 PM with themed activities and food trucks from 6 PM.

events.name: Bands, Bites, and Boats July 2026
events.tagline: Live music, food trucks, and brewery offerings at Bond Lake with optional boat rentals.
events.description: This free Friday concert series features local musician Garland Mason, food trucks Ty's All Natural and Safari Eatz, and Bond Brothers Beer Company at Fred G. Bond Metro Park [1][2].

events.name: Artist Notes featuring Larry & Joe
events.tagline: An intimate evening of music and storytelling with versatile multi-instrumentalists Larry Bellorín and Joe Troop.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 6:30 PM–9:30 PM (Doors 6:30 PM, Concert 7 PM)
events.description: Artist Notes is a free summer concert series at NC State's Centennial Campus where artists perform music and share the stories behind their songs, guided by host Chris Edge [1][2]. The event features local food trucks, free parking, and beer sales benefiting The SIMS Foundation for mental health and substance abuse treatment [1][2].

events.name: Tommy Davidson
events.tagline: In Living Color star Tommy Davidson brings his exceptional stand-up comedy range to Raleigh for a special three-night event.
events.description: Tommy Davidson, known for his role in 'In Living Color,' performs stand-up comedy at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh from July 10–12, 2026, with multiple showtimes each night.

events.name: Jess Hilarious
events.tagline: Stand-up comedian Jess Hilarious brings her high-energy show to Raleigh Improv for a two-night comedy run.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7:00 PM & 9:15 PM · Sat 6:30 PM & 9:00 PM
events.description: Jessica 'Jess Hilarious' Moore, a stand-up comedian and media personality known for appearances on Wild 'N Out and The Breakfast Club, performs four shows over two nights at Raleigh Improv in Cary [1][3].

events.name: Chris Higgins
events.tagline: Nationally touring comedian Chris Higgins brings stoner wisdom and masterful impressions to Goodnights Comedy Club
events.description: Chris Higgins, a nationally touring comedian from Colorado now based in Chicago, performs his 'Don't Tell Comedy' show at Goodnights Comedy Club in Midtown Raleigh from July 10–12, 2026[1][3][5].

events.name: The Pretty Reckless: Dear God Tour
events.tagline: Taylor Momsen-fronted rock band kicks off their 31-stop 'Dear God' World Tour at The Ritz.
events.description: The Pretty Reckless perform their new album 'Dear God' live as they launch the North American leg of their world tour at The Ritz in Raleigh on July 10, 2026.

events.name: Sidecar Social Club at Summerfest
events.tagline: An energetic speakeasy jazz to cabaret set by Sidecar Social Club as the finale of UNC Health Summerfest
events.freeNote: Children 12 and under are free on the lawn; ticket prices from $25.28 to $59.10
events.description: Sidecar Social Club performs an energetic set spanning speakeasy jazz to cabaret as the final event of UNC Health Summerfest at Koka Booth Amphitheatre on Friday, July 10, 2026 at 8:00 PM [1][2][6].

events.name: Friday Night on White 2026
events.tagline: Free outdoor concert series featuring Love Tribe in downtown Wake Forest
events.address: S. White St., Wake Forest, NC 27587
events.description: Friday Night on White is a free monthly concert series held on the second Friday from April through September in downtown Wake Forest, featuring Love Tribe performing classic rock, pop, and dance hits from 6–9 PM on July 10, 2026[1][2].

events.name: PLAYlist Concert Series: Shame Gang
events.tagline: Free summer concert featuring Shame Gang at Durham Central Park
events.scheduleNote: Fri 6:30–10:00 PM · Dinner/drinks at 6:30 PM, DJ at 7 PM, band at 7:30 PM
events.description: The PLAYlist Concert Series presents Shame Gang on Friday, July 10, 2026, at Durham Central Park as part of WNCU's annual free summer concert series held on the first (or special second) Friday of each month from May to October[1][3][4].

events.name: Carolina Flyers Ultimate Frisbee vs Austin Sol
events.tagline: Durham's professional ultimate frisbee team takes on the undefeated Austin Sol for Top Gun Night.
events.description: The Carolina Flyers face the Austin Sol at Durham County Memorial Stadium on Friday, July 10, 2026, as part of the 2026 UFA regular season with Top Gun Night and Military & Veteran Appreciation Night themes.

events.name: BMW Ultimate Driving Experience
events.tagline: Work with real driving professionals to control the power of BMW on Autocross, Street Tours, and Sprint courses.
events.freeNote: Free admission for Autocross timeslot; Sprint and Endurance packages are ticketed
events.description: The BMW Ultimate Driving Experience at Lenovo Center offers a dynamic, hands-on driving program where enthusiasts test BMW vehicles on Autocross, Street Tours, and Sprint courses with professional instructors.

events.name: ADF Presents: Monica Bill Barnes & Company
events.tagline: A New York Times critic’s pick dance version of a memory play titled Many Happy Returns
events.venue: von der Heyden Studio Theater at Rubenstein Arts Center
events.description: Monica Bill Barnes & Company performs Many Happy Returns, a 60-minute dance version of a memory play, at the von der Heyden Studio Theater as part of the American Dance Festival 2026 season [1][2].

events.name: Art Reception - Susan Parrish: An Artist Retrospective
events.tagline: Celebrate Susan Parrish's unique artwork with live music and light refreshments at this free opening reception.
events.description: This free opening reception for Susan Parrish: An Artist Retrospective features live music and light refreshments on Friday, July 10, from 6–8 PM at The Halle Cultural Arts Center in Apex, NC [8][7].

events.name: Ben Flournoy
events.tagline: Ben Flournoy Trio rocks out at Slim's Dive Bar in Downtown Raleigh
events.description: Ben Flournoy Trio performs live at Slim's Dive Bar on Friday, July 10, 2026, from 8:30–10:30 PM with free admission in Downtown Raleigh[1][5][6].

events.name: Madonna Confessions II Listening Party at Bitter Social
events.tagline: Join an exclusive listening party celebrating the release of Madonna's new album Confessions II at Bitter Social.
events.description: Fans can experience Madonna's new album Confessions II in its entirety at this exclusive listening party in Downtown Raleigh, with cocktails available at a special rate of $12 each and food from Centro until 9:30 PM[1][8].

events.name: Riddim & Royalty: A Reggae × Afrobeats Affair
events.tagline: Reggae roots meet Afrobeats heat at a sophisticated, 21+ Signature Friday night.
events.description: Fifty2One Ent presents a premium downtown Raleigh nightlife experience where DJ T-Nyce spins roots reggae, dancehall, Afrobeats, Amapiano, and Soca from 9 PM to 1 AM.

events.name: The Vanguard
events.tagline: Thunderous rock 'n' roll from reunited NC legends with Los Picaros and Hot Mop
events.description: The Vanguard, recently reunited NC legends, perform thunderous rock 'n' roll at KINGS in downtown Raleigh on Friday, July 10, 2026, alongside Los Picaros and Hot Mop[1][3][5].

events.name: The White Buffalo
events.tagline: Singer-songwriter The White Buffalo performs live with special guest Chip Robinson at Lincoln Theatre
events.description: The White Buffalo, a singer-songwriter known for live musical performances, headlines at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh on Friday, July 10, 2026, with special guest Chip Robinson [2][5][9].

events.name: Vastive
events.tagline: An immersive night of industrial bass music with heavy sound and intense stage presence
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: Vastive delivers industrial bass music with a heavy sound and intense stage presence at The Pour House in Raleigh on Friday, July 10, 2026 [1][7].

events.name: Phenom Hoops Live
events.tagline: Massive NCAA-certified live period basketball event for boys ages 14u–17u at Raleigh's premier convention venue.
events.scheduleNote: Session 1: Fri Jul 10–Sat Jul 11; Session 2: Sat Jul 11–Sun Jul 12 (event runs Jul 9–12)
events.freeNote: $545 (17u–14u) for LIVE Session 1; $395–$890 entry fee for Championship in the Capital
events.description: Phenom Hoops Live is a multi-day NCAA-certified basketball tournament featuring live period games for boys aged 14u to 17u at the Raleigh Convention Center, running July 9–12, 2026 with two sessions.

events.name: Salsa at The Park - A Live Music & Dance Series
events.tagline: Free live salsa music and beginner-friendly dance lessons at Knightdale Station Park
events.description: Oak City Music Collective presents a free outdoor salsa series on the 2nd Friday of each month from July to October 2026, featuring beginner dance lessons followed by live salsa orchestra performances and food trucks.

events.name: Live @ATC Tower Music Series
events.tagline: Free outdoor live music on Friday nights under the setting sun at the American Tobacco Campus Water Tower.
events.description: The Lounge Doctors perform at this free Friday night concert series featuring local artists in jazz, bluegrass, and rock styles near the Water Tower.

events.name: Single Woman: Work In Progress
events.tagline: A 75-minute personal storytelling show blending audience participation about being 35, single, and ready to mingle.
events.freeNote: Tickets available at the door (cash or card) or in advance
events.description: Performer Tess presents a 75-minute one-woman show weaving personal storytelling with audience participation about the experience of being 35, single, and ready to mingle[1][6].

events.name: Partner Yoga & Blueberry Evening
events.tagline: Reconnect beneath the summer sky during a romantic and restorative evening of partner yoga and blueberry picking.
events.venue: The Honeysuckle at Union Grove Farm
events.description: Join PTs and yoga teachers Laura Terry and Jacob Tyson for a playful partner yoga session under the pavilion, followed by blueberry U-pick, herbal cocktails, and charcuterie in the garden.

events.name: 2nd Friday Art Walk
events.tagline: Monthly art walk showcasing galleries, studios, live music, and performances in Downtown Carrboro and Chapel Hill.
events.description: The 2nd Friday Art Walk is a free monthly event held on the second Friday of every month from 6–9 PM in Carrboro and Chapel Hill, featuring art galleries, artist studios, live music, spoken word poetry, and performances [1][2].

events.name: Gladys Knight
events.tagline: Legendary 'Empress of Soul' Gladys Knight performs a live concert at Raleigh Memorial Auditorium.
events.venue: Memorial Auditorium at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Gladys Knight, the legendary 'Empress of Soul,' performs a live concert on Saturday, July 11, 2026, at 8:00 PM at Raleigh Memorial Auditorium [2][4][5].

events.name: Paul Simon
events.tagline: Legendary singer-songwriter Paul Simon performs live on his A Quiet Celebration Tour
events.venue: Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek
events.description: Paul Simon performs at Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek in Raleigh on Saturday, July 11, 2026, as part of his A Quiet Celebration Tour [1][8][9].

events.name: North Carolina Courage vs. Washington Spirit
events.tagline: Watch the NWSL's North Carolina Courage take on Washington Spirit in an exciting Saturday night match at WakeMed Soccer Park.
events.description: The North Carolina Courage host the Washington Spirit at WakeMed Soccer Park in a 2026 NWSL match on Saturday, July 11, starting at 6:30 PM. The event features a family-friendly atmosphere with food trucks, drinks, games, and merchandise available.

events.name: NC Courage Tailgate
events.tagline: Free community tailgate celebrating the NC Courage before their home match against Washington Spirit
events.description: The NC Courage Tailgate is a community event at Fenton Square in Cary, offering free admission with registration required before the NC Courage vs. Washington Spirit match on July 11, 2026[6][7].

events.name: Kiki's Comedy Showcase: Sunsets & Standup
events.tagline: A high-energy outdoor stand-up comedy night hosted by local favorite Kiki Wynns in Downtown Cary Park.
events.description: Kiki Wynns returns to Downtown Cary Park for a sold-out series of high-energy comedy shows featuring four hilarious comedians in an outdoor stand-up format at the Academy Pavilion [1][4][5].

events.name: An Evening with Wilco
events.tagline: Two sets of all Wilco at Durham's premier performing arts venue
events.address: 123 Vivian Street / William V. 'Bill' Bell Way
events.scheduleNote: Sat 8:00 PM · Lobby doors open 7:00 PM
events.description: Wilco performs two full sets of their music at DPAC on Saturday, July 11, 2026, as part of their 2026 'An Evening With' U.S. summer tour[2][3].

events.name: Raleigh's All-American Summer Festival
events.tagline: Celebrating 250 Years of America with live music, food trucks, carnival games, and family fun in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Raleigh's All-American Summer Festival is a downtown community event celebrating the 250th anniversary of the United States with live bands, food trucks, carnival games, a kids zone, and contests like the cutest dog and best summer outfit[1][2].

events.name: Big Art Bash
events.tagline: The pARTy of the summer featuring immersive art installations and creative play at Marbles Kids Museum.
events.freeNote: Included in museum admission ($9.50–$12.50 depending on membership)
events.description: Join Marbles Kids Museum on July 11, 2026, from 1–4 PM for a summer celebration of creative expression through play, featuring hands-on art installations and collaborations with local artists in the outdoor Playway.

events.name: July Market at Videri
events.tagline: Ring in summer with the biggest market yet on the breezy Videri Patio
events.description: A handmade and vintage market on the Videri Patio featuring local artists, makers, vintage curators, and food trucks like Harry's Hot Dogs.

events.name: Bastille Day Celebration - Food, Desserts, Wine Walk and Live Music
events.tagline: Travel to France without leaving Raleigh for a festive evening of French wine, food, live music, and a local market.
events.description: This community festival honors French culture with a wine tasting walk, live bands, a French market, and food and desserts at Lafayette Village in Raleigh [1][2][6].

events.name: Dr Bacon — Summer Concerts in the Park
events.tagline: Free Saturday night of funk, rock, soul, and bluegrass at Duke Park
events.description: Dr Bacon performs their signature blend of funk, rock, soul, and bluegrass as part of Durham Parks and Recreation's free Summer Concerts in the Park series at Duke Park on Saturday, July 11, 2026 from 6–8 PM[1][2][6].

events.name: Bingo Loco Afternoon
events.tagline: An interactive three-hour stage show that transforms traditional bingo into a high-energy 21+ entertainment experience.
events.description: Bingo Loco Afternoon is a 21+ interactive stage show at The Ritz in Raleigh, blending bingo with comedy, dancing, and high-energy entertainment for three hours[1][6].

events.name: Daydream Day Party
events.tagline: The #1 Premium Adult Day Party, back for Season 2 with music, dancing, and good vibes.
events.venue: Level7 Rooftop Lounge at the AC Hotel Raleigh North Hills
events.scheduleNote: Sat 11:30 AM–4 PM (Doors at 11 AM; arrive before 1 PM for reserved seats)
events.description: A premium 21+ day party on the rooftop featuring music, dancing, and elevated cocktails at Level7 Rooftop Lounge in Raleigh.

events.name: Dino Dig Live
events.tagline: Join paleontologists live from a dinosaur quarry for an interactive Q&A and expedition experience.
events.description: Paleontologists from the North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences host a live video call from a dinosaur quarry in the American West, allowing in-person and online attendees to ask questions and interact with the field team [1][4].

events.name: NCMA to Go Art Kits: Earth, Art, and Fire
events.tagline: Reserve a free hands-on art kit to explore earth art and fire themes at home with bilingual instructions for all ages.
events.venue: North Carolina Museum of Art, East Building
events.description: This program offers free take-and-make art kits focused on the theme of earth art and fire, featuring materials and written instructions for a complete hands-on project centered on historical artifacts [1][9]. Kits are bilingual (English and Spanish) and designed for all ages, with supplies limited and registration required [1][7].

events.name: UCAN Gardeners as Teachers 2026
events.tagline: Join hands-on workshops rooted in herbs, ancestral knowledge, and community learning at Catawba Trail Farm.
events.scheduleNote: Sat Jul 11 10:00 AM–12:00 PM · Sat Jul 18 10:00 AM–12:00 PM · Sat Jul 25 10:00 AM–12:00 PM
events.description: UCAN's Gardeners as Teachers 2026 offers recurring Saturday morning workshops on herbs and ancestral farming knowledge at Catawba Trail Farm in Durham, with a $25 admission fee and bundle discounts for multiple sessions[1].

events.name: ADF Presents: Footprints: Site-specific work by Stephan Koplowitz
events.tagline: Experience a FREE site-specific dance performance titled (A)Spire inside Durham's historic Mutual Tower.
events.description: Choreographer Stephan Koplowitz presents (A)Spire, a large-scale, site-specific performance transforming Mutual Tower into stage and subject with 10–20 dancers and up to 30 performers including ADF students and Durham community members[1][6].

events.name: ADF Presents: Footprints: Ephrat Asherie, Vincent E. Thomas, & Keith Thompson
events.tagline: Experience four ADF-commissioned world premieres by renowned choreographers in this bridge between performance and education.
events.description: This program features new world premiere works by Ephrat Asherie, Vincent E. Thomas, and Keith Thompson, running 60–75 minutes with a potential intermission.

events.name: Bastille Day Celebration | French music & cocktails
events.tagline: Celebrate Bastille Day with enchanting French music by Sara Zaleta and special French cocktails
events.description: Join Yonder for a Bastille Day Celebration featuring an evening of French music by Sara Zaleta and French cocktails, with admission free for all attendees[1][7][9].

events.name: Blueberry Brunch
events.tagline: Celebrate blueberry season with a laid-back summer brunch featuring fresh local blueberries and seasonal bites.
events.description: The Blueberry Brunch is a seasonal event at Honeysuckle Farm & Gardens in Chapel Hill, offering fresh local blueberries, seasonal bites, and farm-inspired cocktails or mocktails after the meal [4][5][8].

events.name: Coffee with FRANK: Featured Artists Conversation
events.tagline: Join featured artists for an informal conversation over coffee at FRANK Gallery.
events.description: A monthly community event at FRANK Gallery in Carrboro where visitors enjoy coffee and donuts while engaging in an informal conversation with featured member artists.

events.name: Hillsborough Cars - A Car Show for Every Generation
events.tagline: A morning filled with classic cars, customs, muscle cars, and modern rides for every generation.
events.description: Hillsborough Cars is a community car show featuring classic, custom, muscle, and modern vehicles at Eno River Academy on Saturday, July 11, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM[1][4].

events.name: Mortal Combat 1 LAN Tournament
events.tagline: Fight your way through the double-elimination bracket and claim the crown in this $200 cash prize pool tournament.
events.description: This LAN tournament features a double-elimination bracket for Mortal Kombat 1 with a $200 total cash prize pool at Ego Chall Esports in Chapel Hill.

events.name: Walking Stick Whittling Workshop by the Eno
events.tagline: Whittle your very own walking stick by the Eno while learning woodcarving basics and local stewardship.
events.description: Join the Eno River Association for a hands-on walking stick whittling workshop along the Eno River where you'll learn woodcarving basics and natural resource stewardship [2][4]. Participants bring a pocketknife, chair, water, and snack; the organization provides guidance and tools [4].

events.name: History Within Reach: A Seated Tour of Historic Hillsborough
events.tagline: Experience American history through a visual-based, seated tour at one of North Carolina's oldest towns.
events.description: This seated tour offers an alternative to walking tours, covering the same colonial and American history topics of Historic Hillsborough with a knowledgeable guide at the Alexander Dickson House.

events.name: Speakeasy's Queer Cabaret & Dance Party
events.tagline: Celebrate an unforgettable night of drag, cabaret, and dancing at Speakeasy Carrboro.
events.scheduleNote: 9:00 PM: Queer Cabaret hosted by AmanDuh Barron · 11:00 PM: Late-Night Dance Party
events.description: A celebrated LGBTQIA+ event featuring drag performances by Jay Pride and others, hosted by AmanDuh Barron, followed by DJ-led dancing and queer vendors at Speakeasy in Carrboro[2][4].

events.name: As Daylight Dies x Endoxa x Abstractionist
events.tagline: A stacked night of loud, emotional metal built for the pit at Raleigh's underground venue.
events.description: This live metal concert features As Daylight Dies, Endoxa, and Abstractionist performing at Cannonball Music Hall on Saturday, July 11, 2026 [4][5].

events.name: Bedroom Division w/ Fifth Floor, bedrumor
events.tagline: Indie/alt-pop project Bedroom Division takes the stage with special guests Fifth Floor and Five Door Sedan
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: Bedroom Division, an indie/alt-pop project from North Carolina blending polished pop production with nostalgic 80s-inspired synths, performs at The Pour House with Fifth Floor and Five Door Sedan on Saturday, July 11, 2026 at 7:00 PM [1][2][7].

events.name: Brick / Blankstate / Covenant Eye / Weymouth
events.tagline: Charlotte's blankstate. headlines with hometown NC bands Brick, Covenant Eye, and Weymouth
events.description: A live concert featuring Charlotte's blankstate. supported by Raleigh-area bands Brick, Covenant Eye, and Weymouth at KINGS in Downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Kult Ikon
events.tagline: Space doom band Kult Ikon performs live at Slim's Dive Bar
events.description: Kult Ikon, a space doom band, performs live at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh on Saturday, July 11, 2026, from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM[1][8].

events.name: Los Rockoletas
events.tagline: A high-energy night of Spanish rock classics and Latin rock anthems at Chapel of Bones
events.description: Los Rockoletas perform a high-energy set of Spanish rock classics and Latin rock anthems, bringing together generations of rock en español for nonstop dancing at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh on July 11, 2026 [4][5][7].

events.name: United We Dance
events.tagline: The ultimate rave experience with back-to-back EDM drops all night
events.description: United We Dance is an EDM rave event at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh featuring continuous back-to-back drops and festival anthems for an 18+ crowd on Saturday, July 11, 2026.

events.name: WHY? Presents Unzipped
events.tagline: A high-energy, late-night queer underground dance event
events.address: 104 S Wilmington St, Raleigh, NC (upstairs, above Centro)
events.description: WHY? Presents Unzipped is a high-energy, late-night queer underground dance party at Bitter Social in Downtown Raleigh, featuring music and dancing from 9 PM to 2 AM on Saturday, July 11, 2026[2][4].

events.name: One After 919- Beatles Tribute
events.tagline: A live Beatles tribute concert as part of Abbey Road's 6th Annual Outdoor Summer Concert Series
events.description: One After 919 is a Triangle-based Beatles tribute band performing live at Abbey Road Tavern & Grill in Cary on Saturday, July 11, 2026, from 8–11 PM as part of the venue's Outdoor Summer Concert Series[1][4].

events.name: Queer Lake Day
events.tagline: An all-ages, free LGBTQ+ lake day at Jordan Lake, though the event has been cancelled due to park closure.
events.freeNote: Free admission (event), but $10 car entrance fee required at park entrance
events.description: Queer Lake Day was planned as an all-ages, free LGBTQ+ gathering at Jordan Lake on Saturday, July 11, 2026, but has been officially cancelled because the park remains closed.

events.name: Summer Fun Dance 2026
events.tagline: A parent/child dance where kids and parents groove together to family-friendly tunes.
events.description: Join the Summer Fun Dance at The Halle Cultural Arts Center for a mix of nostalgic throwbacks and today's hottest hits in a family-friendly setting [1]. Youth and teens must be accompanied by an adult for this parent/child event [1].

events.name: Adult Restorative Play Group
events.tagline: Let your inner child loose and enjoy playtime for adults at Pullen Park in front of the carousel.
events.description: The Adult Restorative Play Group is a weekly event at Pullen Park where adults can engage in play therapy and fun activities in front of the carousel [5][6].

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Yorktown Coconuts
events.tagline: Coastal Plain League baseball game at Five County Stadium
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Yorktown Coconuts for a competitive Coastal Plain League baseball game at Five County Stadium in Zebulon, NC.

events.name: Birding with Wake Audubon Society
events.tagline: Join Wake Audubon for a morning bird walk in the Museum Park on the second Saturday of the month.
events.description: Birding with Wake Audubon Society is a free monthly bird walk held in the Ann and Jim Goodnight Museum Park at the North Carolina Museum of Art on the second Saturday of each month from 8 to 10 AM, requiring preregistration[1][4].

events.name: Community Kickstand: Free Bicycle Repair
events.tagline: Free monthly bike repair and maintenance help on a first-come, first-served basis
events.description: Raleigh Community Kickstand offers free bicycle repair services and maintenance training at Oak City Cares on the second Saturday of each month from 1–3 PM[1][7].

events.name: Saturday Night Plant Bingo
events.tagline: Join a fun-filled night of plant bingo with six rounds and growing plant prizes every Saturday.
events.description: Saturday Night Plant Bingo is a recurring weekly event at Glass Garden Studio in Holly Springs featuring six rounds of bingo with plant prizes that grow bigger each game, limited to 24 participants.

events.name: The Market at RIW
events.tagline: Shop local artisans, grab food and drink, and enjoy live music on the second Saturday of every month.
events.description: The Market at RIW is a monthly pop-up market at Raleigh Iron Works featuring all local artisans, food and drink vendors, and live music on the second Saturday of each month from 11 AM to 4 PM[1][2].

events.name: World Soccer – Watch Parties for all Nations
events.tagline: Recurring daily watch parties for all World Cup nations at Sports & Social in Cary
events.scheduleNote: Fri 9–11 PM · Recurring daily through July 19
events.freeNote: Free admission. Walk-ins welcome, but reservations recommended
events.description: Daily World Cup watch parties at Sports & Social in Cary featuring all nations' matches, drink specials, and soccer activations from July 11–19, 2026[1][3].

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. Morehead City Marlins
events.tagline: Coastal Plain League baseball game between the Salamanders and Marlins
events.description: The Holly Springs Salamanders host the Morehead City Marlins in a Coastal Plain League baseball game at North Main Athletic Complex in Holly Springs on Saturday, July 11, 2026.

events.name: 2026 Summer Concert Series
events.tagline: Free Sunday evening concerts featuring local artists at Fred Fletcher Park.
events.description: The 2026 Summer Concert Series offers free live music on select Sundays from 6 to 8 p.m. at Fred Fletcher Park, with the July 12 performance featuring the band Invitation [1][2].

events.name: Geek and Grub Market (Anime Edition)
events.tagline: Grab your magical tiaras and increase your power level to 9000 for a FREE, action-packed anime celebration with 40+ vendors, food trucks, and interactive fandom activities.
events.description: The Durham Geek and Grub Market (Anime Edition) is a free, all-ages event featuring over 40 geeky vendors, food trucks, special guests, and interactive anime-themed activities at the Durham Armory [1][2].

events.name: Fairy Lights Bazaar
events.tagline: A whimsical night market for dreamers, wanderers & fae folk
events.description: The Fairy Lights Bazaar is a curated community market hosted by Fleuranoor showcasing local artists selling handmade jewelry, mystical art, enchanted trinkets, and potions.

events.name: Raleigh Really Really Free Market
events.tagline: Bring what you can, take what you need at this monthly no-money exchange.
events.description: A monthly event where people give away and take items for free with no money exchanged, held on the second Sunday of each month at Eliza Pool Park[1][7].

events.name: Raleigh Underground Market
events.tagline: Monthly market and concert series with 50+ local vendors, live music, food trucks, and workshops
events.description: The Raleigh Underground Market is a monthly event featuring 50+ local vendors, diverse musicians, workshops, and food trucks at Midtown Park in North Hills [1][2].

events.name: Sunday DRIFT Rooftop DJ Series at The Velvet Hippo!
events.tagline: End your weekend on a high note with rooftop DJ sets drifting over the Bull City skyline every Sunday.
events.description: Every Sunday from 4–7 PM, enjoy rooftop DJ sets at The Velvet Hippo on Orange Street, featuring rotating resident DJs and monthly Recovery Tea Dance Editions with Gay Agenda and Father Disco[1][2].

events.name: Books on Tap
events.tagline: A Sunday bookish event featuring local indie authors and vendors at an Apex brewery.
events.address: 800 W. Williams St. Ste 140, Apex, NC 27502
events.description: Oak & Ink Bookish Boutiques hosts Books on Tap at Peakway Taps with local indie authors and bookish vendors, offering free admission with an RSVP required [1][3][10].

events.name: Brokencyde / WHOKILLEDXIX / Oni Inc. / Unrepentant / Miss Mxchina
events.tagline: Crunkcore and internet-era night featuring Brokencyde's Neon Dreams Tour
events.description: Brokencyde headlines a crunkcore and experimental electronic music night at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh on Sunday, July 12, 2026, with support from WHOKILLEDXIX, Oni Inc., Unrepentant, and Miss Mxchina[5][7].

events.name: Farmers Market @ Oak City
events.tagline: Fresh local produce, handmade goods, and live music on second Sundays at Oak City Brewing.
events.description: A monthly farmers market held on second Sundays featuring locally grown produce, consumable handmade goods, and live music in an outdoor setting at Oak City Brewing Company.

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. Peninsula Pilots
events.tagline: Minor league baseball game between the Holly Springs Salamanders and Peninsula Pilots at Ting Stadium.
events.venue: Ting Stadium at North Main Athletic Complex
events.description: The Holly Springs Salamanders face the Peninsula Pilots at Ting Stadium in Holly Springs for a Coastal Plain League baseball game on Sunday, July 12, 2026 at 5:05 PM.

events.name: Hunter Blalock with Nolan Reid and the Regulators
events.tagline: Live music featuring Hunter Blalock and Nolan Reid & the Regulators at Raleigh's hidden gem.
events.description: Hunter Blalock performs with Nolan Reid and the Regulators on Sunday, July 12, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 10:00 PM at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Make & Take: Dice Box
events.tagline: Build your own wooden dice box in a hands-on woodworking workshop at Rockler Cary.
events.description: This Make & Take class at Rockler Woodworking & Hardware in Cary guides participants through building a wooden dice box, ideal for tabletop game enthusiasts.

events.name: Serving Brunch: Monthly Drag/ Burlesque
events.tagline: Monthly drag and burlesque brunch on the 2nd Sunday of each month at Chapel of Bones
events.description: A monthly drag and burlesque brunch showcase on the 2nd Sunday of each month at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh, featuring local Triangle producers with VIP tables available.

events.name: Sewing Level 2: Costume Embellishment Workshop
events.tagline: Enhance your costume with fringe, ribbons, fabric, felt, and tassels in this hands-on workshop led by costume designer Emma Droste.
events.description: Led by costume designer Emma Droste, this Sewing Level 2 workshop teaches intermediate techniques for embellishing costumes with fringe, ribbons, fabric, felt, and tassles [4][5]. Participants should bring their own base costume piece and embellishment materials [6].

events.name: The Jam Session Special Edition Shades of Melanin Affair
events.tagline: A curated cultural celebration of smooth jams, class, and good energy for the melanin community.
events.description: Join Sunday, July 12th at Westwood Raleigh for The Jam Session Special Edition 'A Shades of Melanin Affair,' a night of culture, class, and smooth jams celebrating Sunny's 43rd birthday [3][6].

events.name: Unbound - A Bangladeshi Dance Showcase
events.tagline: A community dance showcase celebrating creativity and artistic freedom through Bangladeshi dance.
events.description: Unbound is a community dance showcase that celebrates creativity and artistic freedom, featuring Bangladeshi dance performances by Xavier & Tajeen at Burning Coal Theatre on July 12, 2026.

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Carolina Disco Turkeys
events.tagline: Local baseball showdown between the Devil Dogz and the Disco Turkeys
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Carolina Disco Turkeys at Five County Stadium for a 5:00 PM Sunday baseball game in Zebulon, NC [2][7].

events.name: Jazz Sunday at Incendiary Brewing
events.tagline: Smooth brews and even smoother tunes every second Sunday of the month with Workbook, a Durham-based jazz trio.
events.description: Join every second Sunday of the month from 2–5 PM for Jazz Sundays featuring Workbook, a killer Durham-based jazz trio, at Incendiary Brewing Taproom in Downtown Raleigh[1][6].

events.name: Mill Open House
events.tagline: Explore the historic water-powered gristmill with interpreters and observe its inner workings.
events.description: During the weekly Mill Open House, visitors can explore the historic facility, observe the inner workings of the water-powered gristmill, and speak with historic interpreters about its history [1][2].

events.name: Roaming Readers: July Edition
events.tagline: An audiobook club with a twist that combines walking RTP trails with listening to fiction.
events.description: Join Roaming Readers on July 12 from 9:30–11:00 AM to walk the RTP trails while listening to an audiobook, followed by an optional discussion at Drift Coffee Shop & Kitchen.

events.name: Tattoo Consult Day!
events.tagline: Meet tattoo artists, brainstorm ideas, and book your next appointment during Gold Hand Gallery's monthly open house.
events.description: Gold Hand Gallery hosts its monthly Tattoo Consult Day on Sunday, July 12, 2026, from 1–6 PM, allowing clients to discuss tattoo ideas and book appointments with artists [1][3][5].

events.name: Sundays at Sundown Live Music Series
events.tagline: Free outdoor live music every Sunday evening on the Southern Village green from May to September 2026.
events.description: Sundays at Sundown is a recurring summer concert series featuring live music on the Southern Village green in Chapel Hill, running from May 3 to September 20, 2026, with performances starting at 7 p.m. [1][2][4]

events.name: Sunday Brunch Music
events.tagline: Free outdoor music, fresh air, and delicious brunch on the Carrboro lawn every Sunday
events.description: Join every Sunday on the lawn at Weaver Street Market Carrboro for free local music, fresh air, and brunch while catching up with friends and neighbors[1][3].

events.name: Marvin's Trio Local Live Music
events.tagline: Enjoy free live music by Marvin's Trio on a Sunday morning at Lanza's Cafe.
events.description: Marvin's Trio performs local live music at Lanza's Cafe in Carrboro on Sunday, July 12, 2026, starting at 11:00 AM with free admission.

events.name: Care & Concern: Recent Acquisitions of Modern & Contemporary Art
events.tagline: Explore modern and contemporary artworks acquired by the Ackland since 2020 that reflect artists' cares and concerns about the world.
events.description: This exhibition features modern and contemporary art acquired by the Ackland Art Museum since 2020, showcasing how artists express their cares and concerns about the world around them[2][5].

events.name: Better Than Chocolate (1999) Sapphlix Queer Movie Night
events.tagline: Queer movie night screening the 1999 sapphic classic Better Than Chocolate at Carrboro's Steel String Brewery.
events.freeNote: Ticketed event; admission includes entry to screening
events.description: Sapphlix Queer Movie Night screens the 1999 lesbian comedy Better Than Chocolate at Steel String Brewery Taproom in Carrboro, starting at 7 PM on Sunday.
